label: Whatever COMPREHEND_1s a being COMPREHEND_2s it
paraphrase: OPEN sense bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For every x and y: if x stands in the primitive comprehension relation to y (COMPREHEND_1, Comprehension.Comprehends, definition 4afe4ab4: glossed as knowing y as perfectly as y is knowable), then x knows y at some degree that reaches y's knowability (COMPREHEND_2, definition 1218cc1e). It carries that the primitive's gloss is measured on the one scale of definition 5b196f1c, so that the perfection of a knowing and the knowability of its object are comparable. Given that gloss it is close to analytic; its substantive content is the commensurability. The converse is not assumed (Control part 7). Needed: without it, the COMPREHEND_2 bridge holds and the COMPREHEND_1 bridge fails (Control part 6).
